marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 後來我學會了愛自己 | Hou lai wo xue hui le ai zi ji
Huang guan cong shu ; Di 5036 zhong

In the storms of love, Zhang Xiaoxian stays by your side with calm and grace. Through the bittersweet journey of life, she walks with you—helping you savor even the hardships. "Later, I Learned to Love Myself" is a collection of 129 tender and beautifully crafted essays, offering comfort and insight as you navigate the highs and lows of love and life. You’ve loved others, been loved, been hurt, and hurt others in return. You’ve felt joy, sorrow, disappointment, longing, and the agony of waiting. And then—one day—you come to a quiet realization: gain and loss are not what matter most. What matters is you—the person who has walked through it all and emerged stronger, more radiant, and ready to begin again
